say:1:1620131001:1.text: Professor, we have some honeyfruits here! Is Witstaff back already?
say:1:1620131001:1.source_cn: 教授，我们已经采到蜜果啦！维茨瓦夫回来了吗？

say:4:1620131002:1.text: Here! I've bought the ingredients we need as well as a crucible.
say:4:1620131002:1.source_cn: 在呢在呢，需要的材料和坩埚我都买回来了。

say:7:1620131003:1.text: Great, now we're ready to get to work. Who's up for it?
say:7:1620131003:1.source_cn: 很好，这样材料就齐了，随时可以开始炼制。你们谁来？

say:9:1620131004:1.text: I think... I'm not ready yet.

say:10:1620131005:1.text: As much as I want to try my hand at alchemy, it's safer to leave this one to <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:10:1620131005:1.source_cn: 毕竟是很重要的药剂，虽然我很想试试炼金……但是，这次还...
say:10:1620131005:1.male: As much as I want to try my hand at alchemy, it's safer to leave this one to <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:10:1620131005:1.female: As much as I want to try my hand at alchemy, it's safer to leave this one to <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:11:1620131006:1.text: Good. You've got a clear sense of your own limits.
say:11:1620131006:1.source_cn: 嗯，你对自己能力的认知还算清楚。

say:12:1620131007:1.text: Professor, I'm not immune to your blunt criticisms...
say:12:1620131007:1.source_cn: 教授，听见这么直接的评价，我还是会有点伤心的……

say:15:1620131008:0.text: Professor, you can trust <style="stress"><player_name></style>! He's the best mage around!
say:15:1620131008:0.male: Professor, you can trust <style="stress"><player_name></style>! He's the best mage around!
say:15:1620131008:0.female: Professor, you can trust <style="stress"><player_name></style>! She's the best mage around!

药效：能够对灵体起到有效的镇定作用。
配方：依次加入<style="highlight">宁神草</style>、<style="highlight">安宁紫叶</style>、<style="highlight">蜜果</style>，熬煮至融化后涂抹在灵体表层。
